title: Targeted Visual Revision Request
description: The decision payload for resolve_visual_approval() when decision=revision_requested. target_shot_ids empty/omitted means the whole package needs rework; a non-empty list scopes regeneration to only those shots, keeping every other shot's asset assignment untouched (see create_visual_revision()). See docs/architecture/visual-asset-pipeline.md#targeted-revision.

target_shot_ids.description: Empty/omitted = revise the entire shot list. Non-empty = regenerate only these shots; every other resolved shot's asset assignment carries over at zero cost.
